description.fallback: In a hotel room, Avdol wakes up Joseph as the group prepares to go eat breakfast. Polnareff yells at Joseph as old men are supposed to wake up early. Avdol chuckles as seeing that Joseph turned one hundred eighty degrees while asleep (his head now facing north) is also a sign of his youth.
